title: PNG line start filter byte and scan line length
summary: Each decompressed scanline of a non-interlaced PNG has 1 byte of filter type followed by pixel data packed by bit depth and channel.
detail: A 13-pixel wide 1-bit grayscale line needs to be rounded up to get 2 data bytes, plus 1 filter byte.
boundary: Adam7 interlaced images need to calculate the scanning line width of each pass separately.
relevance: If each row is offset by one byte when reconstructing pixels, check whether the filtered bytes are included in the pixel.
